			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = paddy_fields_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_paddy_fields_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = paddy_fields_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = paddy_fields_04 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = paddy_fields_04
			aub_can_upgrade_to_paddy_fields_05_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = paddy_fields_04
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = paddy_fields_05 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = paddy_fields_05
			aub_can_upgrade_to_paddy_fields_06_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = paddy_fields_05
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = paddy_fields_06 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = paddy_fields_06
			aub_can_upgrade_to_paddy_fields_07_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = paddy_fields_06
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = paddy_fields_07 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = paddy_fields_07
			aub_can_upgrade_to_paddy_fields_08_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = paddy_fields_07
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = paddy_fields_08 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
	}
}
